reason: The cited evidence supports that MA+SPS can produce uniform, fine microstructures and suppress grain coarsening in high-entropy alloys, but none of the passages specifically address W-Cu systems, thermal transport properties, or direct comparisons to conventional casting/sintering of W-Cu. The key premises about W-Cu are therefore extrapolated rather than directly supported.
premises: Mechanical alloying (MA) produces uniform, fine, nanocrystalline W-Cu powders
Spark plasma sintering (SPS) can suppress grain coarsening and eliminate voids
MA+SPS yields a uniform and dense microstructure in W-Cu
MA+SPS improves thermal transport and mechanical durability over conventional casting/sintering
